ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a minimal ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels appearing only in localized scratches and spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark field across 95%+ of visible fluke area. High-intensity pixels are distributed as fine-scale linear abrasions and isolated point-clusters (diameter <10 pixels) primarily on the right lobe and peduncle base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 65-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged trailing edge with pronounced serration. Right lobe displays at least 6 distinct macro-peaks; left lobe shows a continuous sequence of smaller, higher-frequency pixel-level peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips, with the right lobe showing a more irregular, notched terminus than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixel formations (3-10 pixel diameter) scattered on the right lobe distal region and lower peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple overlapping, high-contrast white linear disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-150 pixels) visible across both ventral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and small circular scars visible on the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip is uniquely characterized by a multi-notched, jagged geometric profile compared to the relatively smoother left tip.
